skills.line: This should be enough to finish you off!
skills.description: Ibaraki Douji focuses his energy into fierce black flames and attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Rage Outlet (迁怒/八つ当たり)
skills.line: You dare hurt my friends? Prepare to pay for what you've done!
skills.description:
When Ibaraki Doji KO's a non-summoned enemy, he inflicts 50% of the excess damage to all enemies and consumes all Fury Fire stacks. If he fails to perform a KO, he gains a stack of Fury Fire, max of 3 stacks.
